Following a pullback in one of the world’s most crowded markets, a chipmaker index rose 6.9%. The S&P 500 increased by 2.3%. The Nasdaq 100 gained 3.4%. news.title: US CPI Prep (November 10th)
news.description: On Tuesday, November 10th, at 08:30 ET, the BLS releases the October CPI report. NOTE: No year-over-year figures will be published for October, as the 2025 government shutdown left the corresponding comparison data unavailable. This places greater emphasis on monthly price changes and the underlying components of inflation. Here are some views on what to expect.
